title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (P300) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal P300 speller dataset combining EEG and eye-tracking recordings from 31 healthy participants across 3 sessions each. The dataset comprises 2,520 trials from a row-column visual speller paradigm with 64-channel EEG (plus 1 EOG and 1 stimulus channel, 66 channels total) acquired at 1000 Hz, designed to support brain-computer interface research and ocular activity analysis during P300-based communication tasks.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuroscan Quik-Cap 65-channel system with SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate. The montage followed the standard 1005 electrode placement with 64 EEG channels, 1 EOG channel, and 1 stimulus channel (66 channels total). Reference electrode was placed at the right mastoid (M1) with ground at the forehead. Ag/AgCl sensors were used with online high-pass filtering (10 s time constant). The P300 paradigm employed a row-column speller with visual row-column flash stimulation at 50 Hz line frequency.
